title: 7344 E Highway 36
description:
Property Site: https://view.paradym.com/v/7344-E-Highway-36-Hamilton-TX-76531/4879525

7344 E Highway 36
Hamilton, TX 76531
$416,000, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,578 SF, MLS# 552086

Goodbye City Life! Welcome to the country!  This wonderful property has been lovingly cared for by the owners. With 3 BR and 2 BA, and over 1500 sq ft on 4.58 acres, your family will have plenty of space to grow. The  enormous living and kitchen area is open and 'roomy' enough for family gatherings. The large master ensuite hosts a beautiful shower and a large soaking tub. The two minor bedrooms are a good size with a hall bath in between. 
A porch on the front and the back of this home makes 'porch sitting' very peaceful. The views are incredible. The detached garage is large and can be used as a workshop/man cave....or possibly a 'she shed'.  The pole barn gives great coverage for a boat or cars. The roof and the HVAC was replaced in 2020. Located between Jonesboro and Hamilton, makes this place a great location. Other information to note: Circle T arena is just down the road, and North Fort Cavazos 40 minutes away, and an hour away from Fort Cavazos. Gatesville is a 24 minute drive on Hwy 36.  Meridian State Park and Mother Neff State Park are nearby. Did I mention that one of the oldest trees, if not the oldest tree in Hamilton County is on this property? 
Call your favorite realtor today to see this beautiful property today!

2 full bath
